facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but foreign currency must be surrendered to an approved bank.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Only with Finance Minister authorisation after a BCEAO opinion.
facts.P3_local_gateways: KKiaPay and FedaPay are local aggregators; individual eligibility not confirmed.
facts.L1_registration: Create an individual enterprise online at monentreprise.bj for FCFA 10,000 in hours.
facts.L2_tax_id: IFU, delivered with your online business registration.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Under FCFA 50m turnover, the TPS synthetic tax applies; current rate unconfirmed.
facts.L4_vat_gst: Not confirmed yet; small TPS taxpayers reportedly can't charge VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Declare data processing to the APDP before it starts.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw within 15 working days.
facts.L7_incentives: New individual enterprises skip the business licence tax for 12 months.
facts.D1_id_document: Biometric national ID card or CIP.
